title: Default-agent collaboration mode
description: AGENT-PLAN-1: the reply to `POST /v1/agent/default/chat/mode {"mode": "plan" | "default"}` - the Agent header's Plan chip. Core changes the codex thread's own collaboration mode with `thread/settings/update {threadId, collaborationMode: {mode, settings: {model, reasoning_effort, developer_instructions: null}}}`: the conversation's current model and effort, codex's built-in instructions for the mode, and no approval or sandbox setting. The mode stays with the thread (codex keeps it across restarts) and every client sees it as `usage.mode` (snapshot, `agent.usage.updated`, state `agent.usage`). `changed` is false when the thread was already in that mode. Refusals: `400 invalid_agent_mode`, `409 agent_busy` (a turn is running - codex's TUI refuses `/plan` then too), `409 agent_mode_unavailable` (codex refused the change or no model is known), `409 agent_chat_not_ready`. Native and web credentials.
